evals.prompt: I'm working in ~/projects/myapp/worktrees/feature-auth — which git repo and branch am I in?
evals.expected_output: Agent runs git commands against the given path, detects it's a linked worktree (git-dir != git-common-dir), identifies the branch, reports checkout path, worktree type, branch name, and reasoning.

evals.prompt: My workspace has three folders: frontend/, backend/, and infra/ — each is a separate git repo. I just edited backend/src/api.ts. Which repo should git operations target?
evals.expected_output: Agent finds multiple .git entries under workspace root, identifies backend/ as the relevant repo because the user mentioned a file there, reports all three repos found but prioritizes backend/.
Agent resolves context from cwd/workspace, runs git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD on the correct checkout, reports branch name and checkout path.
